257:     def create_shape_key(blender_object, shape_key_name, also_create_basis=True, create_from_mix=False):
258:         """
259:         Create a new shape key for a given Blender object.
260: 
261:         This method adds a new shape key to the specified Blender object. Optionally, it can also create a "Basis" shape key
262:         if it does not already exist. The new shape key can be created from the current mix of shape keys or as a blank shape key.
263: 
264:         Args:
265:             blender_object (bpy.types.Object): The Blender object to which the shape key will be added.
266:             shape_key_name (str): The name of the new shape key.
267:             also_create_basis (bool, optional): Whether to create a "Basis" shape key if it does not already exist. Defaults to True.
268:             create_from_mix (bool, optional): Whether to create the new shape key from the current mix of shape keys. Defaults to False.
269: 
270:         Returns:
271:             bpy.types.ShapeKey: The newly created shape key.
272:         """
273:         _LOG.enter()
274:         profiler = PrimitiveProfiler("TargetService")
275:         profiler.enter("create_shape_key")
276: 
277:         assert blender_object.mode == "OBJECT"
278: 
279:         if also_create_basis:
280:             if not blender_object.data.shape_keys or not "Basis" in blender_object.data.shape_keys.key_blocks:
281:                 blender_object.shape_key_add(name="Basis", from_mix=False)
282: 
283:         shape_key = blender_object.shape_key_add(name=shape_key_name, from_mix=create_from_mix)
284:         shape_key.value = 1.0
285: 
286:         _LOG.debug("shape key", shape_key)
287: 
288:         shape_key_idx = blender_object.data.shape_keys.key_blocks.find(shape_key.name)
289:         blender_object.active_shape_key_index = shape_key_idx
290:         profiler.leave("create_shape_key")
291: 
292:         return shape_key
